On Mon, Oct 5, 2025 at 18:05 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Aditya / Marissa — forwarding Globex's note and redlines. TL;DR: they need confirmation on AI endorsement, cyber retro date (claims-made?), and a COI sample. Procurement wants answers by Oct 12.

Thanks for the ping. Quick take:

- AI: we can provide Additional Insured on the General Liability and Auto policies via an endorsement; we should avoid relying on the COI alone for AI coverage. Proposed language: 'Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and affiliates shall be named as additional insured on the Commercial General Liability and Business Auto policies with respect to liability arising out of Redwood's services under this Agreement.' (I will refine to match Globex's entity list once they provide final names).
- Cyber: our primary cyber policy is claims-made. We can propose a retroactive date of the policy inception for contractually required retro dates up to 24 months prior subject to underwriter approval. If Globex requires an open retro beyond our carrier's comfort, that will need underwriting sign-off and may affect pricing/ability to commit.
- Limits: standard: GL 1,000,000 / 2,000,000; Auto 1,000,000; Cyber/E&O 1,000,000 aggregate (we may offer 2,000,000 on a case-by-case basis). If they need higher limits, we'll need to route an underwriting exception.
- Territorial: no APAC carveouts in our policy wordings by default; confirm with broker for carrier-specific endorsements.

Action items for next 48 hours:
1) Aditya: ask Ellen to pull COI sample and AI endorsement draft and confirm retroactive date flexibility.
2) Soojin: get the full entity list Globex wants named as AI (including affiliates).
3) I'll prepare a clean redline version with the proposed AI language.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
